name: leafkin_druid_pays_from_the_menu
notes: Bug hunt 2026-11-17 (hunt5). Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a cast is paid by the sources the engine taps (BACKLOG 'Automatic payment'). Leafkin Druid's '{T}: Add {G}. If you control four or more creatures, add {G}{G} instead.' is a Conditional, which the payer never priced, so the Druid made no mana in a real game; its packs had activated it directly. Controlling fewer than four creatures, it adds {G} and pays Sedge Scorpion ({G}): the menu offers the cast (the act op) and taps the Druid. Woodland Mystic's '{T}: Add {G}' always did (the control).
